noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

title:
This annotation is used to mark elements of structure as being invalid in various languages. Since the uber AST is a
superset of all languages, much of validation is marking what is not supported in particular languages.

If a feature is supported in all version of a language, that field should be unset. If supported in no version, the
field should be set to "none". If set to a version, the feature is only supported in that version and above.


```type
enum type Code.BinaryOperator {

  @code(java="none", js="2016")
  EXP = '**'
}
```

In the above example, the exponentiation operator is not supported at all in Java, is supported in all version of
Python and only in ES2016 and higher JavaScript.

For Java, notable versions are: "1.8", "15" and "17".

For Python, notable versions are "2.6" and "3".

For JavaScript, notable versions are "5" and "2015"; see [estree](https://github.com/estree/estree).
name: Ann.Code
